column1: # Shared recipe oracle. tools/recipe.py and test/test_chord_core both read this file.
# Columns, tab-separated: name, recipe, failed, overflow, events, skips.
# Escapes in recipe and skip text: \\ \t \n \r \xNN. \xNN is one byte.
# events: OP:Kind:code:gap joined by ';'. OP is W, P, or R. code and gap are decimal.
# skips: length:too_long:text joined by ';'. too_long, failed, and overflow are 0 or 1.
# A factory output that parses with a skip, overflow, or failed is a build error.
# Caps around 96 events and 32 skips stay in test_recipe_token_and_cap_bounds.
